contract.category: Document/control purpose, not subject keywords; operational sign-in is login.
contract.coverage: Every retained meaningful input/button/anchor receives an explicit audit disposition and reason.

independence.inheritedContextCaveat: Historical product facts present in user/task context were not used to decide source annotations. No product output files were opened.
independence.versionUse: Read only permitted VERSION provenance; external paths named by VERSION were not followed.

method.visibilityBoundary: Retained controls with no explicit hidden attribute/style/aria-hidden ancestor were audited. Original CSS, pixel visibility, offscreen/carousel state and runtime behavior were not observed.
method.inputBoundary: Editable values were excluded from extracted metadata and decisions. Only fixed button-type input labels and fixed title/name/id were used.
method.sourceIdentityBoundary: data-eval-id and data-source-node-path are audit bookkeeping; no product mapping is proposed.
coverageChecks: All labeled retained controls resolve to one accepted entry per version.
No rejected entries exist in either version.
Expected and task source references resolve.
limitations: Five reduced fixtures, not complete live pages.
No destination fetch, click, authentication, submission, download or installation.
Hidden event listeners and opaque runtime behavior are outside static evidence.
Audit counts are raw coverage/change counts; no product accuracy, recall, recommendation or task-success metrics were computed.

findings.finding: Original annotation says navigate despite explicit rolebutton/popup markers. Development corrected copy already uses locate.

Five original same-origin links have destination pathnames different from the current document; their fragments do not make them local controls. Corresponding expected/task actions and task wording follow navigation. Development copy already has these action/instruction corrections.

historicalNote.assessment: SMU historical note says all fragments imply locate. Development VERSION explicitly preserves and supersedes that statement. It is historical provenance, not a new action correction.

findings.finding: Both versions mark two plain HTTPS login-form links locate. Under the supplied contract, their action is navigate and category remains login. No explicit SSO, handler, popup, download, rolebutton or same-document fragment marker is present.
findings.provenanceNote: VERSION lists these as unresolved under a prior ambiguity. The task contract now explicitly covers plain login links; no hidden behavior is invented.

findings.finding: Both faithful fixture copies retain an actual text input titled 검색어 입력 with id/name searchText inside the service-search form. It has neither data-eval-id nor accepted/rejected annotation. This is an annotation coverage omission, not evidence of a product recommendation or input leakage.
findings.reason: A fixed-metadata locator can identify the actual search field without reading or submitting its contents. No change to expected membership is proposed.
findings.historicalCountCaveat: The observation sourceControlCount=6 describes the historical selected labeled controls. This audit finds seven retained controls on that page; do not rewrite the historical observation as a fresh observation.
